Package com.project.cooking.kitchen

Class StockManager

java.lang.Object
com.project.cooking.kitchen.StockManager
public class StockManager extends Object
Manages stock and expiry monitoring of kitchen ingredients and issues alerts through the KitchenManager.

abood

    • checkStockLevels

      public void checkStockLevels(List<Ingredient> ingredients)
      Checks the stock levels of ingredients and issues alerts based on thresholds. Issues a general alert if stock is below the reorder threshold. Issues an urgent alert if stock is critically low (less than 2).
      Parameters:
      ingredients - list of ingredients to check
